nodes.name: Every Hour
nodes.notes: Runs hourly. Adjust to your latency tolerance — every 15 min, every 6h, daily, etc.

nodes.name: Set Domain
nodes.notes: Single domain per run. To poll multiple domains, replace this Set with a Code node that emits one item per domain — the rest of the workflow runs once per item automatically.

nodes.name: Sync New Jobs
nodes.notes:
First run: pulls up to 500 most recent jobs (jobs_seen_after unset). Subsequent runs: only emits jobs first_seen_at >= last sync time.

State lives in workflow static data ($getWorkflowStaticData('global').lastSeenByDomain). Survives workflow restarts. Reset by editing the Code node to clear it.

Auth: set SUBSPACE_API_KEY in n8n env, or hard-code in the code.

If a domain has more than 500 new jobs in one polling interval, this misses the tail — increase poll frequency or add an offset loop (see template 03).
